title: Injection Guard plugin for WordPress before 1.4.0 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows…
description: Injection Guard plugin for WordPress versions before 1.4.0 has a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to trick a logged-in administrator into triggering a password hash export. The vulnerability arises because the ig_settings admin page processes GET parameters without nonce verification. Exploitation results in writing WooCommerce customer email and password hashes to an unprotected file, which can be downloaded without authentication for offline cracking.
